extraction.policy_summary: Persistent Systems has an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy aligned with the RPwD Act, 2016, covering the entire employee lifecycle (recruitment, hiring, compensation, learning and development, career progression, workplace practices). It explicitly prohibits discrimination on the basis of disability and affirms responsibility for an inclusive, accessible, safe and respectful work environment, supporting reasonable accommodations and barrier-free environments.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: 58 permanent differently abled employees reported (46 male, 79.31%; 12 female, 20.69%); 0 other-than-permanent; differently abled workers marked Not Applicable. Confirmed separately as an ESG goal performance metric: '58 Specially abled people' against the diverse-workplaces inclusion goal, out of a total workforce of 27,502.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Persistent offices include accessible parking spaces, ramps at entry points, elevators, appropriate signage, disabled-friendly restrooms, and height-adjustable workstations, including provisions to support wheelchair users. All entry/exit points of major campuses have been modernised to enable smooth entry/exit for PWDs. All India-owned facilities, including leased facilities, are stated to be accessible to Persons with Disabilities, with periodic reviews and audits conducted to strengthen accessibility.
extraction.digital_accessibility_measures: Persistent follows recognised accessibility standards and adheres to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0) to enhance accessibility of internal digital platforms. Assistive technologies and reasonable accommodations are provided where required to support employees with specific needs.
extraction.recruitment_details: The EEO Policy states commitment to equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities across the entire employee lifecycle, explicitly including recruitment and hiring. No numeric hiring target, disability-specific outreach programs, or attainment figures are reported.
extraction.compliance_details: The Company states it adheres to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0) for its internal digital platforms, and states its offices/premises are accessible in line with the RPwD Act, 2016 and the Harmonised Guidelines issued thereunder. No RPwD Act statutory quota attainment percentage is reported.

evidence.quote: Persistent Systems has Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy, which is aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 ... across the entire employee lifecycle--recruitment, hiring, compensation, learning and development, career progression, and workplace practices.

Persistent offices are designed to accommodate the needs of persons with disabilities and include features such as accessible parking spaces, ramps at entry points, elevators, appropriate signage, disabled friendly restrooms, and height adjustable workstations, including provisions to support wheelchair users.

In the digital environment, Persistent follows recognised accessibility standards and adheres to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0) to enhance accessibility of internal digital platforms.

Persistent is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including persons with disabilities, across the entire employee lifecycle--recruitment, hiring, compensation, learning and development, career progression, and workplace practices.
Persistent follows recognised accessibility standards and adheres to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0) to enhance accessibility of internal digital platforms.
